notes.title: Thank you so much for amazing Next Fest, dear players of Olderiada!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Next Fest was incredible for [i]Olderiada[/i]—thank you, from the bottom of my heart, to everyone who played the demo![/b][/p][p]This is only the beginning of the journey. Early Access will launch soon, featuring [b]five vibrant heroes[/b] and [b]Chapter One of the main campaign[/b].[/p][p]A bit of history: the world of Olderiada is 27 years in the making. Two kids first imagined it while playing [i]Heroes of Might and Magic I[/i] back in the previous millennium; eight years ago, I began turning that dream into a game. I’m now polishing the first campaign chapter and aim to release it [b]by the end of this week[/b]—sleepless nights, but I can’t stop![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636033/4eb805069d506d700ef61b7339d18849f2855379.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I’ll also share daily updates that dive deeper into the lore and design of Olderiada.[/p][p]Thank you again for your support![/p][p][i]Igor Karpenko[/i]
Developer of [b]Olderiada[/b][/p]

notes.title: Get Ready for Olderiada at Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45636033/b542af2011061203392f071a8a2fa03f35b3d8a6.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]🎭 Get Ready for Olderiada at Steam Next Fest! 🎭[/h3][p][b]Demo coming to Steam Next June 2025![/b][/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that [b]Olderiada: Constellation of Fables[/b] will take part in [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], starting [b]June 9, 2025[/b]! Dive into a whimsical yet tactical fantasy world and lead your oddball heroes through legendary battles![/p][p]🎮[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432560/Olderiada/"]Download the Demo on Steam[/url][/p][p][b]In Olderiada[/b], cunning is stronger than brute force. Take command of a [b]vivid[/b] cast of strategists, scholars, and unusual heroes in tactical real-time battles. Build mighty castles, uncover bizarre artifacts, and carve your story into a vibrant world brimming with mystery and adventure.[/p][p][/p][h3]Demo Features:[/h3][p]🛡 [b]Three Epic Battles[/b]
Fight your way through handcrafted scenarios:[/p][list][*][p][i]The Duskspire Clash[/i] — a mountain siege where fate hangs on every formation[/p][/*][*][p][i]Sanctuary of Broken Oaths[/i] — an ambush among the ruins of trust[/p][/*][*][p][i]Battle for the Essence of Soul[/i] — a surreal war for something deeper than power[/p][/*][/list][p]⚔ [b]Command & Control[/b]
Lead armies, take direct control of your hero in third-person combat, and turn the tide of battle with smart positioning and clever tactics.[/p][p]🏰 [b]Castle Mode[/b]
Manage your stronghold, gather resources, and prepare for incoming threats in [i]Tough Times for Oldiery[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]🎉 [b]Play the Demo[/b] during [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] and help us shape the full release!
Join our [url="https://discord.gg/FEs2mq7BcG"]Discord [/url]to share feedback and be part of the growing [b]Olderiada[/b] community.[/p][p]Let the legend begin — [i]See you on the battlefield![/i][/p]
